content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I'm wondering if it's possible to use the following expansion modules together on a [product_name] without issues: one module for pt100, one module for 0-20mA, and two modules with 8 digital inputs/outputs each. My concern is that the total outputs would be greater than 16.

Hello. Refer to [product_name] ..[article_no] plus [product_name] TD (see Maximum setup in section 2.1.1). Any outputs beyond the 16th will not be accessible, since this exceeds the system's supported connections.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking information about configuration limits when connecting multiple analog and digital expansion modules to a [product_name]. The main concern is understanding how many outputs can be addressed, particularly when exceeding 16 outputs. This highlights the need for clearer guidance in the interface or documentation about these limits.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] system to support all connected expansion modules, even when the number of outputs exceeds 16, and are looking for confirmation about compatibility and system limitations.
